title: QualityForge test manifest
description: Integrity manifest for the generated test suite (review R2, guard 1). Recorded by the orchestrator when the Testing Agent finalizes tests; re-hashed by the Verify gate (spec section 7.8) before the quality report is issued. Any digest drift fails the gate — the mechanical enforcement of the no-test-tampering rule (spec section 11.4).

manifest_version.description: Format version of the manifest itself.

run_id.description: The run this suite belongs to (spec section 9, Run.run_id).

recorded_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of finalization. Format validity is enforced by tools/validate.py.

recorded_by.description: Review R2 assigns the recording to the orchestrator, acting on the Testing Agent's finalized suite.

path.description: Repository-relative POSIX path of the test file. Absolute paths and '..' traversal are rejected by tools/validate.py.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file content at finalization time (review R2).

bytes.description: File size in bytes at finalization time; advisory.

criteria_refs.description: Acceptance criteria this test file exercises (spec section 7.6: tests derive from criteria, not from reading the implementation).
